prompts.name: 曲苔石径
prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE ordinary independent small aquarium decoration, on a square transparent canvas.
Input image 1 is the approved root-cottage edit target / paint reference. Replace the ENTIRE architecture with the requested ordinary decoration below. Reuse its refined hand-painted Japanese fantasy environment-art finish, subtle desaturated contours, organic textures, emerald/sage/olive green family, weathered gray-green stone or aged chestnut wood ONLY where the requested subject needs that material, and soft green-filtered upper-left lighting.
This is a SMALL prop or plant, not a landmark building. No cottage parts, roofs, doors, windows, room, pavilion, tower or little house attached. Do not turn everything into an architectural arch. Keep a clean, legible silhouette and a modest amount of detail that survives thumbnail viewing.
One compact decor unit, complete and uncut, on a square canvas with at least 8% transparent margin on every side and 10% below its feet/root. Real RGBA transparency outside and in natural gaps. No black/olive background haze, vignette, rectangular water, ground island, soil terrain sheet, painted cast shadow, floating sparkle halo, text, symbols, UI, fish, people or animals. No plastic 3D, photorealistic rendering, candy colors or bright gold trim. Do not include any second unrelated prop.

Subject: one compact GENTLY CURVING STEPPING-STONE PATH UNIT comprising five broad flat worn gray-green stones in a shallow S curve. A little olive moss clings to their edges, but the gaps between the five stones are fully transparent. Show the upper stone surfaces with only mild perspective suitable for an aquarium floor. Each stone remains part of this one grouped decor unit. No road rectangle, terrain, dirt, grass carpet, house, railing or plants around the unit.
